_comment: Runtime switches for the unattended 04:00 run. RUNBOOK.md §6 is the only consumer. Edit this file, commit, push — no other file changes when the policy changes.

billing._prefer_unlim: Every run asks the server whether seedance_2_5 carries an unlim allowance RIGHT NOW (models_explore action=get). If it does, the generation is submitted with use_unlim:true and costs nothing. This is the intended path and the one the owner asked for.
billing._credit_spend_authorized: What happens on a day when unlim is NOT available. false = do not spend, log NO_UNLIM_NOT_AUTHORIZED, exit 0 without generating. true = fall back to credits (use_unlim:false) within every limit in RUNBOOK.md §6. Set to true ONLY on the account owner's explicit instruction — it authorises a recurring real-money charge of ~90 credits per day, every day, unattended. As of 2026-08-15 seedance_2_5 carries no unlim support and the account allowance reads {available:false}, so with this flag false the run reports instead of producing a video.

model._id: Locked by the owner. Not substituted for an unlim-eligible model without an explicit instruction — seedance_2_0 / seedance_2_0_mini / kling3_0 / gemini_omni / wan2_7 are the unlim-eligible ones, and switching would change the look of the channel.

git._push_is_fatal: A failed push never aborts a run that already produced a video. Log GIT_PUSH_FAILED and exit 0; the video and its metadata stay on disk.
